events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect patch, README row, seed line, clone state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; P=workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches; ls $P/tantra-backend-v2/ | grep ad7abb; head -5 $P/tantra-backend-v2/fr-ad7abb*.patch; grep -c '^diff --git' $P/tantra-backend-v2/fr-ad7abb*.patch; grep -o '^diff --git [^ ]*' $P/tantra-backend-v2/fr-ad7abb*.patch; grep -n 'ad7abb' $P/README.md; sed -n 14p workshop-plan/tasks/features/seed.py; ls ~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2 >/dev/null && git -C ~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2 log -1 --format='%h %s' development; git -C ~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2 status --short | head -3; git l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check dashes, test commands in spec, Mongo availability
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; S=workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fr-ad7abb_add-lead-running-campaign--SPEC.md; python3 -c "import sys;t=open('$S').read()+open('workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md').read();print('dashes',sum(t.count(c) for c in '–—'))"; grep -n -i -E 'mongo|jest|npx|npm|MONGO' $S | head -15; wc -l $S; (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/27017) 2>/dev/null && echo mongo-up || echo mongo-down; which docker mongod 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read test section of spec; check docker
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 36,63p workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fr-ad7abb_add-lead-running-campaign--SPEC.md; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo docker-up || echo docker-down; docker images mongo --format '{{.Tag}}' 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scratch archive of development, git am patch, start throwaway Mongo
events.input: $ set -e; C=~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2; ls -d $C/node_modules >/dev/null; D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/t396v.XXXX); echo $D; git -C $C archive development | tar -x -C $D; cd $D; git init -q; git add -A >/dev/null; git -c user.email=a@b -c user.name=v commit -qm base; git am -q /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fr-ad7abb_add-lead-running-campaign-test--f0b901e.patch && echo AM-OK; ln -s $C/node_modules node_modules; docker run -d --rm --name t396v-mongo -p 27018:27017 mongo:7 >/dev/null && echo mongo-started

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find earlier scratch copies with node_modules
events.input: $ ls -d /tmp/*/node_modules /tmp/*/*/node_modules 2>/dev/null | grep -v t396v | head; ls /tmp | grep -i -E 't396|t152|scratch|backend' | head

events.text: Still checking: the patch applied with `git am`. Next I'm installing the test dependencies so I can run the suite.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Install dependencies in scratch copy
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; rm -f node_modules; ls package-lock.json yarn.lock pnpm-lock.yaml 2>/dev/null; (npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error >/tmp/t396v-npm.log 2>&1 && echo NPM-OK) || tail -5 /tmp/t396v-npm.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run regression suite with patch applied
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; RUN_CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO=1 CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018 npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/domains/contacts/contact-append.integration.spec.ts src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -E '✓ one lead|✕|^Tests:|^Test Suites:'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show failing test details
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; RUN_CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO=1 CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018 npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/domains/contacts/contact-append.integration.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -E -A25 '●' | head -70

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun suite, list per-test results
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; RUN_CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO=1 CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018 npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/domains/contacts/contact-append.integration.spec.ts src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.spec.ts > /tmp/t396v-run.log 2>&1; grep -E '✓|✕|^Tests:|PASS|FAIL' /tmp/t396v-run.log | head -40

events.text: Run 1 had 2 failures and run 3 passed 27 of 27. To find out whether the suite is flaky or Mongo was just cold, I'm running it three more times and keeping any failure output.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run suite 3 times to check flakiness
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; for i in 1 2 3; do RUN_CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO=1 CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018 npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/domains/contacts/contact-append.integration.spec.ts src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.spec.ts > /tmp/t396v-run$i.log 2>&1; grep '^Tests:' /tmp/t396v-run$i.log; grep -m3 -E '✕|● .* ›' /tmp/t396v-run$i.log; done

events.text: The suite passed 4 runs in a row. Next I'll restart Mongo and run straight away to check whether the first failure came from a cold Mongo.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Cold-Mongo rerun to reproduce first failure
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; docker restart t396v-mongo >/dev/null; RUN_CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO=1 CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018 npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/domains/contacts/contact-append.integration.spec.ts src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.spec.ts > /tmp/t396v-cold.log 2>&1; grep '^Tests:' /tmp/t396v-cold.log; grep -E -A12 '● ' /tmp/t396v-cold.log | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clear jest cache, cold rerun
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t396v.fheR; npx jest --clearCache >/dev/null 2>&1; docker restart t396v-mongo >/dev/null; RUN_CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO=1 CONTACT_APPEND_MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018 npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/domains/contacts/contact-append.integration.spec.ts src/domains/contacts/campaign-contact-intake.spec.ts > /tmp/t396v-cold2.log 2>&1; grep '^Tests:' /tmp/t396v-cold2.log; grep -E -B2 -A14 '● ' /tmp/t396v-cold2.log | grep -v '^\s*$' | head -45
